paths.description: Requested URL and geographic access-restriction/recovery page; audited because it is the first experience for this external IP.
The gateway’s sole recommended alternate URL, representing the public role-selection, announcements, navigation, and sign-in entry surface.

findings.summary: The requested gateway is not mobile-responsive and is malformed.
findings.evidence: At a 360px viewport the layout primitive reports no viewport meta and a 980 CSS-pixel layout scaled to 0.367. DOM evidence also shows no doctype/title/lang/headings, and the screenshot shows a broken image.
findings.suggestedFix: Replace the legacy centered font markup with a valid semantic document, viewport meta, fluid CSS, and a working image URL.

findings.summary: Core navigation and sign-in controls lack robust accessible semantics.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse accessibility is 0.83 and flags an unnamed logo link; the image audit finds 19 of 23 images without alt. The probe finds visible username/password/CAPTCHA inputs with no label or aria-label.
findings.suggestedFix: Add persistent labels and accessible names, meaningful or empty alt as appropriate, and use semantic landmarks and native dialog behavior.

findings.summary: The usable alternate landing page misses the good LCP threshold.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse measures LCP 4.5s, FCP 2.3s and performance 0.81 on the alternate page.
findings.suggestedFix: Prioritize the LCP resource, shorten render-blocking chains, and reduce initial image/font work.

findings.summary: Important labels and notices fail minimum color contrast.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse finds contrast ratios from 2:1 to 3.53:1 for “Yeni” ribbons and red application links, below the required 4.5:1.
findings.suggestedFix: Replace low-contrast red/pastel and shadow combinations with tested semantic color tokens meeting WCAG AA.

findings.summary: The requested origin omits browser security headers, while the alternate origin has a weakened CSP.
findings.evidence: The headers primitive finds no CSP, HSTS, nosniff, frame protection, Referrer-Policy, or Permissions-Policy on e-okul.meb.gov.tr. The alternate origin supplies these but permits unsafe-inline and unsafe-eval.
findings.suggestedFix: Apply HSTS, nosniff, frame-ancestors, strict referrer and permissions policies to both origins, then migrate scripts/styles to nonce/hash-based CSP without unsafe-eval.

findings.summary: Neither the gateway nor the alternate landing page adapts to user display preferences.
findings.evidence: Desktop and emulated dark/reduced-motion screenshots are visually identical; computed color-scheme is normal. The alternate page still has running 2s animations and Lighthouse reports contrast failures down to 2:1.
findings.suggestedFix: Declare color-scheme, provide dark tokens, disable non-essential animation under prefers-reduced-motion, and test high-contrast colors.

findings.summary: Keyboard focus and target sizing are inconsistent.
findings.evidence: The probe shows multiple navigation links with outline:none when focused and several visible action links are only 16px high. Hidden mobile-menu links remain represented with zero-sized rectangles.
findings.suggestedFix: Add a strong :focus-visible style, ensure collapsed content is removed from the tab sequence, and provide at least 24px targets with 44px preferred for primary actions.

findings.summary: Critical resources have inefficient caching and render-blocking delivery.
findings.evidence: The alternate HAR records 36 requests and 837,057 transferred bytes. Lighthouse estimates 698 KiB cache savings, 1,190ms render-blocking savings, and flags font-display and LCP discovery.
findings.suggestedFix: Set durable immutable caching for versioned assets, defer non-critical CSS/JS, use font-display, and explicitly prioritize the LCP asset.

findings.summary: Metadata and indexing signals are incomplete or broken.
findings.evidence: The requested gateway returns HTTP 403 and has no title or meta description. The alternate page has a title but no description, canonical, hreflang, JSON-LD, or Open Graph metadata and skips h1 entirely.
findings.suggestedFix: Return an intentional indexable status for the public gateway and add a descriptive title/description, canonical, h1, and accurate organization/service share metadata.

findings.summary: Authentication appears password-only and lacks autofill/passkey affordances.
findings.evidence: The alternate-page probe finds username and password fields with empty autocomplete values and no WebAuthn/passkey surface; no permission prompts fired on load.
findings.suggestedFix: Add correct username/current-password autocomplete immediately, then offer passkey authentication and reauthentication where supported.

findings.summary: The app-like education service has no installability or offline fallback metadata.
findings.evidence: Both probes find no web app manifest; discoverability confirms server rendering but no installable/offline surface is exposed.
findings.suggestedFix: Add a manifest and a conservative service worker that provides an offline/retry shell without caching sensitive authenticated data.

findings.summary: Language metadata is missing on bilingual and Turkish pages.
findings.evidence: Both DOM probes return html.lang=null even though the gateway contains Turkish and English and the alternate page is Turkish.
findings.suggestedFix: Set the primary html lang and wrap the secondary-language gateway paragraph with its own lang attribute; use logical CSS properties for direction-safe layout.

findings.summary: Sign-in fields lack the semantics needed for clear, humane validation and autofill.
findings.evidence: The probe finds username, password, and CAPTCHA fields with no labels, no required attributes and mostly empty autocomplete tokens. This prevents reliable error association and input assistance.
findings.suggestedFix: Add labels, required/aria-invalid/error associations, validate after interaction, and use username/current-password autocomplete tokens.

findings.summary: Image delivery is legacy and misses basic sizing/lazy-loading optimizations.
findings.evidence: The image audit finds all 23 images missing width/height, 21 legacy PNG/JPEG assets, seven below-fold images not lazy-loaded, and no modern-format images.
findings.suggestedFix: Add intrinsic dimensions, lazy-load below-fold imagery, and serve right-sized AVIF/WebP with responsive sources where useful.

findings.summary: A production script throws a syntax error on load.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse reports SyntaxError: Unexpected token export in theme/able/assets/js/popper.js at line 2460.
findings.suggestedFix: Serve the correct Popper build for the script loading mode or load the ESM build with type=module, then verify a clean console.

findings.summary: Document structure does not provide a reliable reading hierarchy.
findings.evidence: The gateway has no headings or landmarks. The alternate page has no h1/main and jumps directly to repeated h5 headings; Lighthouse flags the missing main landmark.
findings.suggestedFix: Use one descriptive h1, ordered section headings, and a main landmark; keep focus order aligned with the visual order.

findings.summary: The gateway document and image markup are invalid or broken.
findings.evidence: The gateway has no doctype, places a title element inside a style block, and uses a quoted malformed data URL that renders as a broken 16x16 image without alt or dimensions.
findings.suggestedFix: Emit a valid HTML5 document, move title into head, correct the image URL, and add dimensions plus appropriate alt text.

findings.summary: Navigation and modal state changes use abrupt legacy behavior rather than modern, preference-aware transitions.
findings.evidence: DOM/probe evidence finds no View Transition use; the gateway uses a timed meta refresh and the alternate page uses Bootstrap modal classes.
findings.suggestedFix: Use same-document or cross-document View Transitions for meaningful state changes, with reduced-motion fallbacks.

findings.summary: The page ships avoidable legacy and unused code.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse estimates 32 KiB unused JavaScript, 23 KiB unused CSS, 21 KiB unminified JavaScript, and 10 KiB legacy JavaScript savings.
findings.suggestedFix: Remove unused Bootstrap-era dependencies, minify production scripts, and serve a modern bundle without redundant legacy code.
